notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5821 and PB5825 landed): the mode tier consults the attempted mode (FileConnector.OpenModeView, PB5200) and then the mode the file IS open in (FileConnector.OpenedModeView), so an OPEN INPUT of a file open OUTPUT or EXTEND that fails '41' runs the OUTPUT or EXTEND procedure (GR6c/d: 'open in the output mode'); where both modes have a procedure the attempted mode's runs (the text names no order). The globalOnly tier excepts the files the container's non-GLOBAL USE statements name (PB5821). The WHEN EXCEPTION open-mode arm (ControlFlowEmitter.EmitMatcherArms) reads both views.
